title: Eight generation stress
description: A bicycle courier must deliver a medical package across a city during a severe storm. The route is blocked, the courier changes course, helps an injured pedestrian, loses time, finds an alternate crossing, reaches the clinic, hands over the package, and finally rests as the storm eases. Decompose this into eight distinct feasible Generations.
